lava_version_info:
LAVA reference LD - release 1.1

Source: UK Biobank (N = 100,000)
Range: up to 10 Mb
Storage format: eigen [float/int16]
- window: 250
- pruning: 0.999 / -0.01
Truncation: 0.005 / 0.025 (> 2.5 Mb window)
Filters: missingness < 5%, MAF >= 1%, no AT/CG alleles
scope: read-only metadata/source comparison, no BED decode/bcor payload read/numerical imports/fits/calibration/outcomes
